features.quote: hotels across the street (ALL IN ONE)
features.rationale: The description states that the hotels are across the street from the venue and labels the setup ALL IN ONE, so event and accommodation share one location.
The festival offers 10 hours of workshops as part of the event.

features.quote: 1 100,000% Kizomba room / 1 Salsa Bachata Fun room
features.rationale: The festival lists two separate dance rooms, a Kizomba room and a Salsa Bachata Fun room.
The description names an official hotel and gives a festival offer rate, with breakfast excluded and no accommodation included in the pass.
